query: SELECT `id`, IF(CHAR_LENGTH(CONCAT_WS('', LOWER(DATABASE()), '.', 'webhook-', `endpoint`)) BETWEEN 1 AND 64, CONCAT_WS('', LOWER(DATABASE()), '.', 'webhook-', `endpoint`), SHA2(CONCAT_WS('', LOWER(DATABASE()), '.', 'webhook-', `endpoint`), 256)) AS `__lock` FROM `checked_webhooks` WHERE IS_USED_LOCK(IF(CHAR_LENGTH(CONCAT_WS('', LOWER(DATABASE()), '.', 'webhook-', `endpoint`)) BETWEEN 1 AND 64, CONCAT_WS('', LOWER(DATABASE()), '.', 'webhook-', `endpoint`), SHA2(CONCAT_WS('', LOWER(DATABASE()), '.', 'webhook-', `endpoint`), 256))) IS NULL ORDER BY `id` LIMIT ?
